tips.text: Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy extra Cerebrum relics; it is the Rare part in most of them and the bottleneck.
Buy her relics from the Market's Prime Resurgence tab on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Refine Uncommon and Rare relics to Radiant and leave Common ones Intact, since Radiant lowers a Common's odds.
Run Radiant relics in a squad that all brought the same relic so everyone rolls for the Rare.
Pick a teammate's identical reward on the reward screen so they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Free two Companion slots before claiming; Carrier Prime arrives with its Sweeper Prime.
